content.value_statement: Manual OpenAPI client updates are slow and can drift from the backend contract. This skill guides Orval generation and TypeScript checks so teams can refresh clients consistently.
actual_capabilities: Checks for the OpenAPI specification at backend/src/main/resources/static/api-docs.yaml.
Runs the frontend package script that generates the Orval API client.
Verifies that generated API client files are present in the expected directory.
Runs a TypeScript noEmit check after client generation.
Prepares a completion report with generated file paths and next steps.
limitations: Assumes the OpenAPI specification exists at a fixed backend path.
Assumes the frontend project defines a generate:api package script.
Does not create or repair Orval configuration files.
Does not validate runtime behavior of the generated client.

use_cases.title: Refresh frontend clients
use_cases.description: Regenerate typed API access after backend OpenAPI changes and confirm TypeScript compatibility.

use_cases.title: Check contract delivery
use_cases.description: Confirm that the published OpenAPI file can produce frontend client types without generation errors.

use_cases.title: Prepare release branches
use_cases.description: Run a repeatable client generation workflow before review, merge, or release validation.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a client
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a standard project layout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the generate-api-client skill to check the OpenAPI file, run Orval generation, verify generated files, and run TypeScript checks.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh after backend changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow after API contract updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate the frontend API client from the current backend OpenAPI specification and summarize any generated file changes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate before review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for pull request readiness.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the API client generation workflow, verify the generated directory, run TypeScript validation, and report any blockers for review.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose generation failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting when generation or typing fails.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the API client generation steps, stop at the first failure, identify the failing phase, and explain the next corrective action.

output_examples.input: Generate the frontend API client from the current OpenAPI specification.
output_examples.output: The OpenAPI file was found, Orval generation completed, generated files were verified, and TypeScript validation passed.

output_examples.input: Refresh the API client after backend endpoint changes.
output_examples.output: The client was regenerated from the latest contract, and the report lists the generated API and model files.

output_examples.input: Check why API client generation failed.
output_examples.output: The workflow stopped at the generation phase and reported the failing command, likely cause, and next corrective step.

best_practices: Review the OpenAPI specification diff before regenerating client files.
Run the workflow on a clean branch so generated changes are easy to review.
Inspect project package scripts before allowing command execution in untrusted repositories.
anti_patterns: Running package scripts from an unknown repository without inspection.
Ignoring TypeScript errors after generating a new API client.
Editing generated client files manually instead of updating the source contract.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It guides Orval generation for a typed TypeScript API client from an OpenAPI YAML file.

faq.question: Which OpenAPI file path does it expect?
Does it configure Orval for me?
faq.answer: No. The project must already include the Orval configuration and package script.

faq.question: Does it run project commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the agent to run frontend package and TypeScript commands.

faq.question: Can it fix schema errors?
faq.answer: It can identify the failing phase, but schema repairs must be handled in the project source.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
